title: Lost and Found
summary: A student dropped their Fordham ID somewhere between McShane and Edwards Parade. Find it and take it to Public Safety in Thebaud Hall.

offer: Oh no, oh no. I dropped my Fordham ID somewhere between here and Edwards Parade!
Could you help me look for it?
decline_say: No worries. I'll keep looking round McShane.

teaches: Public Safety is in Thebaud Hall
A found ID goes to Public Safety

say: Thank you! I came out of McShane and walked towards Edwards Parade.
If you find it, take it to Public Safety in Thebaud Hall. They'll make sure it gets back to me.

steps.name: lost ID
steps.hint: Look along the road between McShane and Edwards Parade. Watch for the "!".
say: You found a Fordham ID card lying in the road!

steps.label: Take the ID to Public Safety (Thebaud Hall)
steps.hint: Thebaud Hall is on the south side, by Rose Hill Manor Drive.
say: You hand the ID in at Public Safety. They'll get it back to its owner.

done_say: Now you know where Public Safety is, if you ever lose something or need help.
